rows.raw: Priced at the client's CURRENT discount tier (the tier their existing block qualifies for) — NOT cumulative. Topping up never unlocks a deeper discount; deeper discounts come only from a bigger UP-FRONT block. Over-buying is safe — unused credits carry to next year — so clients are steered to commit more up front.
